paragraphs.text: Shimatsu (shi-MAHT-soo) is an oni overlord from Kamigawa that was active during the Kami War .

Like other oni, Shimatsu's dominion over dark and destructive forces twisted him into a being of pure malevolence. Shimatsu has red skin, a bony, horned face with jagged teeth and a long twisting tongue, and three lamprey-like mouth appendages on his back. Like all oni, he has a large third eye present in his forehead.
